reason: Inspected comparisons support evaluating context-file cost and usefulness rather than assuming generated repository overviews improve task success.

candidates.title: Evaluate repository instructions as a cost-bearing intervention
candidates.rule: Before adding automatically generated repository context, compare it with the existing instructions on task completion and inference cost; include only guidance whose practical value is demonstrated.
candidates.passage: LLM-generated context files increase cost and don’t improve performance
candidates.finding: Generated files have no statistically significant pooled success effect and raise average cost by 20% on SWE-bench and 23% on CTXbench. Developer files outperform generated files but their improvement over no files is not statistically significant.
candidates.conditions: Four agent/model settings; files generated from pre-patch repository state, with developer-provided files available for CTXbench.
candidates.limitations: Task resolution does not measure all benefits such as security or compliance. File length has no significant effect in reported ablations, so this is not evidence that merely shortening files improves performance. Retain required project instructions.
candidates.validation_test: On representative issues compare current guidance with proposed additions, tracking success, cost and required engineering constraints. Keep necessary instructions and reject unhelpful additions based on held-out results.

review_scope: Selected abstract, introduction, methods or main-result sections; not a comprehensive paper or appendix review.
